original_summary.uncertainty: Three repetitions on a shared host. Ranges/CV are descriptive, not confidence in production SLOs; profiles are separate from timing.

slow_receivers.interpretation: Functional barrier experiments on the unshared resource path: database execution completed before held frontend delivery, every small result was checked, and cancellation/deadline/disconnect refunds passed. Large work may be explicitly rejected at the byte limit. These are not matched-core shared-pool timing or a scheduling speedup estimate.

uncertainty: Every repetition retained. Three shared-host runs give descriptive ranges, CV and paired repetition ratios; no outlier removal, causal isolation, statistical significance or production SLO is established. Before/after batches are separated in time. Instrumented observations never stand in for normal timing. Broader canonical release criteria remain open.
